test_matches_pattern: test PolicyMatcher.matches_pattern to check if a value matches wildcard patterns like '*' or 'prefix-*'
test_scope_matches: test PolicyMatcher.scope_matches to verify a policy scope matches a request context by teams, keys, models, and tags
build_get_matching_policies: build a call to PolicyMatcher.get_matching_policies to retrieve policy names matching a given request context
review_get_policies_with_matching_condit: review PolicyMatcher.get_policies_with_matching_conditions to filter policies by evaluating their conditions against a context
test_get_matching_policies_from_registry: test PolicyMatcher.get_matching_policies_from_registry to fetch policies from the global attachment registry for a context
